title: RAF Wellington Aircrew
memorial_details: Rectangular board with moulded edges, painted to resemble stone. RAF badge flanked by 2 other badges are located across the top, above the dedication in black, upper and lower-case script.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF THOSE WHO DIED AT STAPLE FARM WITHINGTON / ON 19th APRIL 1943 / IN A VICKERS WELLINGTON AIRCRAFT OF THE ROYAL AIR FORCE / [7 Names] / THEY SHALL GROW NOT OLD, AS WE THAT ARE LEFT GROW OLD: / AGE SHALL NOT WEARY THEM, NOR THE YEARS CONDEMN. / AT THE GOING DOWN OF THE SUN AND IN THE MORNING, / WE WILL REMEMBER THEM.
custodian: St Michael and All Angels' Church
